# AstroSpike

> Free, fully client-side diffraction-spike studio for astrophotography: automatic star
> detection, four spike/bloom presets, per-star tuning, and full-resolution export —
> nothing is ever uploaded.

AstroSpike is a client-side diffraction-spike studio for astrophotographers, built with
Angular. Drop in an astrophoto, let it detect the stars, and it renders diffraction spikes
scaled to each star's real brightness — then export the result at full resolution. Nothing
is uploaded anywhere: every pixel is processed in your browser.

## Core Features
- **Automatic Star Detection**: Converts the image to luminance, models the sky background
  so nebulosity and gradients do not trigger false detections, thresholds above the noise,
  and measures each connected source. Hot pixels, satellite trails, and large diffuse blobs
  are rejected so only genuine point sources are spiked. Detection runs in a Web Worker.
- **Four Style Presets**: Subtle, Classic (the four-armed Newtonian look), JWST (six-armed),
  and Diffusion — a spike-free mode that blooms the stars like a soft filter on the lens.
  Each preset bundles the falloff curve, glow radius, and thickness.
- **Brightness-Aware Rendering**: Spike length and intensity scale with each star's measured
  flux, and the spike colour is sampled from the star's own core. Each arm carries a
  chromatic gradient — cool at the root, red at the tip, the way diffraction spreads light
  by wavelength. Spikes composite additively over the original pixels.
- **Global and Per-Star Controls**: How many of the brightest stars get spikes, spike
  length, chroma, diffusion, brightness, rotation, and a 4- or 6-spike toggle. Click any
  star to include or exclude it, double-click to tune it alone (length, brightness,
  rotation, and its own diffusion), place a star detection missed, or drag a detection onto
  the star's true core. A comparison divider wipes between the original and the result.
- **Export**: PNG (lossless) or JPEG (adjustable quality) at the source image's original
  resolution, or the spikes alone as a transparent PNG layer for compositing over a 16-bit
  master in another editor.
- **Sample Images**: Opens on a bundled Pleiades (desktop) or Cygnus Wall (mobile) frame so
  the studio can be tried without an astrophoto at hand.
- **100% Client-Side**: No backend, no account, no uploads. Works offline once loaded.

## Supported Input
PNG and JPEG. Large frames (60+ megapixels) are supported: the preview is downscaled for
responsiveness while the export renders at native resolution.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Angular 21 (Standalone Components, Signals)
- **State Management**: Angular Signals
- **Styling**: TailwindCSS 4
- **Image Processing**: Framework-free TypeScript detection and rendering functions running
  on Canvas, with detection off the main thread in a Web Worker
